nodes.name: Corrosion-driven Ni₃S₄/NiFe-LDH heterostructure
nodes.procedure: Ni₃S₄/NiFe-LDH/IF is synthesized in just 1 h through immersing IF in a mixed solution containing NiCl₂ and Na₂S₂O₃ at room temperature and atmospheric pressure. During spontaneous IF corrosion, a compositional and gradient structure forms, with Ni₃S₄ dominating the surface and NiFe-LDH enriching the core. Specifically, in the anodic region, the iron substrate and S₂O₃²⁻ undergo oxidation reactions to form Fe³⁺ and S²⁻. In the cathodic region, dissolved oxygen obtains electrons and reacts with water to produce OH⁻. Subsequently, the S²⁻-rich solution reacts with Ni²⁺, promoting Ni₃S₄ formation at the solution interface. Finally, restricted outward diffusion causes Fe³⁺ to accumulate near the foam surface, where it rapidly coordinates with Ni²⁺ and OH⁻ to form a NiFe-LDH-rich inner layer.

unit_operations.name: Anodic corrosion
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: Fe → Fe³⁺ + 3e⁻ and S₂O₃²⁻ → S²⁻ + SO₃²⁻ + 2e⁻

nodes.characterization_summary: Raman shows Ni-S stretching modes at 217 cm⁻¹ and 276 cm⁻¹ for Ni₃S₄, Ni²⁺-O vibrations at 468 and 541 cm⁻¹; operando Raman shows structural reconstruction with γ-NiOOH peaks at 475 and 559 cm⁻¹, FeOOH at 685 cm⁻¹, and SO₄²⁻ at 981 cm⁻¹.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Raman spectrum of S-FeOOH/IF exhibits a distinct Fe³⁺-O vibrational mode at 676 cm⁻¹. Both NiFe-LDH/IF and Ni₃S₄/NiFe-LDH/IF show characteristic Ni²⁺-O vibrations at 468 and 541 cm⁻¹. Notably, Ni₃S₄/IF and Ni₃S₄/NiFe-LDH/IF display additional signature bands at 217 cm⁻¹ and 276 cm⁻¹... operando Raman spectra reveals that Ni₃S₄/NiFe-LDH/IF undergoes structural reconstruction... new peaks at 475 and 559 cm⁻¹, uniquely assigned to the Eg and A₁g vibrational modes of γ-NiOOH... 685 cm⁻¹ peak confirms the in situ formation of FeOOH... characteristic SO₄²⁻ Raman peak at 981 cm⁻¹

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS shows positive binding energy shifts in Ni₃S₄/NiFe-LDH vs NiFe-LDH: Fe 2p shifts of 0.67 eV (Fe³⁺) and 0.26 eV (Fe²⁺), Ni 2p shifts of 0.33 eV (Ni³⁺) and 0.54 eV (Ni²⁺); Ni(III)/Ni(II) ratio 0.875 vs 0.733; S 2p at 162.30/163.23 eV; depth profiles show S decreasing from 22.1 to 8.7 at%, Fe increasing from 9.2 to 21.6 at%, with valence state gradients.
nodes.evidence_snippet: High-resolution X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) analysis of both NiFe-LDH and Ni₃S₄/NiFe-LDH... positive binding energy shifts of 0.67 eV (Fe³⁺ 2p₃/₂) and 0.26 eV (Fe²⁺ 2p₃/₂) along with corresponding positive shifts of 0.33 eV (Ni³⁺ 2p₃/₂) and 0.54 eV (Ni²⁺ 2p₃/₂). These shifts indicate that electrons transfer from NiFe-LDH to Ni₃S₄... Ni(III)/Ni(II) ratio increases from 0.733 in NiFe-LDH to 0.875 in Ni₃S₄/NiFe LDH... S 2p spectrum displays two spin-orbit peaks, S 2p₃/₂ at 162.30 eV and S 2p₁/₂ at 163.23 eV... XPS depth profiling... sulfur, the content at the outermost layer reaches 22.1 at% and gradually decreases to 8.7 at% after 20 s of etching... iron... increases from approximately 9.2 at% to 21.6 at% at 20 s of etching
